SELECT max(updated_at) as new_watermark
FROM public.claims;

query.value: INSERT INTO pipeline_run_log (pipeline_name, run_id, table_name, old_watermark, new_watermark, rows_copied, status) VALUES ('@{pipeline().Pipeline}', '@{pipeline().RunId}', 'claims', '@{activity('LKP_OldWatermark').output.firstRow.watermark_value}', '@{activity('LKP_NewWatermark').output.firstRow.new_watermark}', 0, 'NO_CHANGES') RETURNING log_id

SELECT *
FROM public.claims
where updated_at > '@{activity('LKP_OldWatermark').output.firstRow.watermark_value}'
and
updated_at <= '@{activity('LKP_NewWatermark').output.firstRow.new_watermark}'
UPDATE watermark_table SET watermark_value = '@{activity('LKP_NewWatermark').output.firstRow.new_watermark}' WHERE table_name = 'claims' RETURNING watermark_value

INSERT INTO pipeline_run_log (pipeline_name, run_id, table_name, old_watermark, new_watermark, rows_copied, status) VALUES ('@{pipeline().Pipeline}', '@{pipeline().RunId}', 'claims', '@{activity('LKP_OldWatermark').output.firstRow.watermark_value}', '@{activity('LKP_NewWatermark').output.firstRow.new_watermark}', 
    @{activity('CP_Claimns_Incremental').output.rowsCopied}, 'SUCCESS') RETURNING log_id
